description: Merge PDF files into one document. Can you run shell commands? Then do not send base64: upload the file from disk with curl -F file=@<path> https://helpyself.com/api/v1/tools/pdf-merge (same tool, same answer, much faster). A HelpySelf tool (helpyself.com).

files.description: The PDFs to join, in the order their pages should appear in the result. Needs at least two, and no more than 30 in one request.

items.description: One PDF to include, with all of its pages.

data.description: This PDF's bytes, base64-encoded. A data: URL prefix is stripped. Send the whole file as it is, up to 20 MB: do not crop, shrink or split it first. If you can run shell commands, do not write the base64 out yourself: send the file from disk with curl -F file=@<path> -F <option>=<value> https://helpyself.com/api/v1/tools/pdf-merge (add -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" if you have one); the answer is the same JSON.

name.description: Filename used to identify this PDF in the response's `sources` list and in any error message about it.

name: pdf_merge
title: Merge PDF
